summary: GFXSS MIPI-DSI Waveshare 4.3" (800x480 shown, 832x480 RGB565 buffers x2 in gfx_mem) + VG-Lite GPU init, bare-metal vsync flag; panel MCU @0x45 via SCB5 (i2c-scb5-cm55); CM33_NS part enables the GFXSS clocks
api: proj_cm55: board/display.h; proj_cm33_ns: board/display_clocks.h (call display_clocks_enable() before board_start_cm55())

(int32_t vg_lite_hal_wait_interrupt\(uint32_t timeout, uint32_t mask, uint32_t \*value\)?
\{?
#if _BAREMETAL?
)[\s\S]*?(?
#else /\*for rt500\*/)
patches.why: bare-metal VG-Lite GPU wait: no timeout + reads *value unset (TESAIoT SDK finding)
patches.source: own fix; problem noted in the TESAIoT SDK third_party_patches/mtb-dsl-pse8xxgp

hw_settings: Waveshare 4.3" DSI panel on J10 (FPC); on the bare AI Kit also J16 (5 V + touch I2C, not fitted by default)
tesaiot: the panel MCU 0x45 and touch 0x38 share SCB5 with the QWA309 parts - if SCB5 is held low, set CS select OFF (hw-troubleshooting)
source: own code; guidelines (read, never copied - Infineon EULA: binary redistribution only): Infineon mtb-example-psoc-edge-gfx-lvgl-demo v2.6.1, E84_TouchUI (github.com/NnopponS/WheelSense_Project firmware/E84_TouchUI), TESAIoT SDK proj_cm55/gfxss_config.c + proj_cm33_ns/main.c
notes: BSP 1.4.0 has no gfxss block: config structs written in display.c, mipi_dsi_cfg from the Waveshare library; gfx_mem 0x1C4000 = 2 x 798720 B buffers + 253952 B VG-Lite heap (non-cacheable on CM55 via BSP MPU region); _BAREMETAL left at its default 1 (VG-Lite polls, no GPU NVIC handler); DC interrupt -> flag + 500 ms wait timeout; SCB5 bus clear + panel init retries (SDK warm/cold-boot findings)
verified: 2026-10-11 tesaiot (second board, Waveshare 4.3" DSI), app lvgl-demo (dual, bare metal both cores): serial_test 9/9 PASS (display/GPU/touch OK, display IRQs ~110/s, frames flushed, 0 timeouts); full 800x480 frame rendered in 6-7 ms with VG-Lite; user saw the UI correct; 3 taps -> 3 button clicks at (174,210); slider drag -> 100 at x=791 (mirroring correct)
